title: leichhardtia microlepis

The therapeutic actions of Leichhardtia microlepis include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as its potential to improve digestion and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Leichhardtia microlepis include harpagoside, a glycoside compound, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
